bosses.name: Battle-Hardened Domovoy Sculptor: Gale Hewing
mechanics: Starts with 90% all resistance. About 8 seconds into combat, it begins sculpting an ice statue and repeats this about every 16 seconds.

Apply Radiance: Stellar Glimmer during sculpting to interrupt the statue. The detonation deals 1,000,000 HP damage and reduces RES by 25 percentage points for Anemo or 20 for other elements; up to 3 stacks.
The ice sculptures cannot generate Superconduct stacks.
Big-Mouthed Jack Frost: interrupt the Prime Ice sculpture or it becomes a hostile animal statue that launches snowballs.
Creative Frenzy: the ley-line disturbance increases starting RES and statue frequency; the harmless statue explosion reduces all RES and further reduces Anemo RES, up to 3 stacks.
bosses.note: The selected window applies the listed resistance by damage element. The damage model does not simulate the statue timing or its fixed 1,000,000 HP backlash.

traits.name: Big-Mouthed Jack Frost
traits.description: When battle begins, the Nemesis will harness Anemo energy to create a Prime Ice sculpture. After a short delay, the sculpture will transform into a Big-Mouthed Jack Frost that continuously launches snowballs. Inflict Radiance: Stellar Glimmer on the Nemesis while it is creating the sculpture to interrupt the process and turn the ice sculpture into a harmless animal statue instead.

traits.name: Creative Frenzy
traits.description: Due to the effects of the Ley Line disturbance, the Nemesis will start the battle with greatly increased All Elemental RES and Physical RES and will create Prime Ice sculptures more frequently. After an ice sculpture is transformed into a small animal statue, it will explode following a brief delay, dealing damage to the Nemesis and reducing its All Elemental RES and Physical RES, while further reducing its Anemo RES. This effect can stack up to 3 times.

bosses.name: Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device - Obliterator Panoply
mechanics: Immediately enters Sweeper Mode with 200% all RES. Flow Momentum rises while it attacks; Cryo hits lower it and can stop the spin.
Cryo hits faster than once every 0.6 seconds can trigger a first-threshold event that grants 36 Energy to the party once Flow Momentum falls below its threshold.
When stunned, Cryo RES falls to -30%; other RES falls to 30%.
Nightsoul Mode has 110% all RES and summons two tracking pillars. Keep its gauge at zero to stop them.
Forced Counterstrike Mode can lower RES further, but the source does not publish a fixed numeric resistance for that sub-phase.
Each Sweeper cycle can produce additional Elemental Orbs the first time its spin is stopped.
bosses.note: Choose the phase that matches your damage window. Enter the actual boss particle/orb event in Energy; the calculator starts every character at 0 Energy.

traits.name: Preemptive Sweeper Mode
traits.description: Will immediately enter Sweeper Mode when combat starts: All Elemental and Physical RES is greatly increased, and it will generate Flow Momentum while performing attacks. The higher its Flow Momentum, the faster it will rotate and the more DMG it will deal. It will lose Flow Momentum after taking Cryo DMG. Below a certain Flow Momentum value, it will stop rotating and attacking, and its All Elemental and Physical RES will be greatly decreased, with its Cryo RES decreasing still more. Each time it enters Sweeper Mode, it will produce additional Elemental Orbs the first time its rotating attacks are stopped.

traits.name: Forced Counterstrike Mode
traits.description: If an active character enters and maintains the Nightsoul's Blessing state for a time, this opponent will enter Forced Counterstrike Mode and switch to attacking with powerful tracking rays. At this time, its All Elemental and Physical RES will be decreased. In this state, after it takes a certain number of Cryo DMG instances, it will cease attacking altogether and its All Elemental and Physical RES will be further decreased.

traits.name: Damage-Resistant Structure
traits.description: Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, this great foe has its All RES further increased, and it loses less Flow Momentum when struck by Cryo DMG. It will also lose less RES when in Forced Counterstrike Mode.

bosses.name: Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow: Endless Reverberation

phases.name: Before shield break · resistance not listed

mechanics: HP cannot initially fall below 80%. Near 81% HP, it creates a 42U Cryo Shield; this can happen up to twice.
If Stellar Glimmer affects the Cryo Shield, its remaining shield percentage converts to an HP shield worth up to 15% of max HP.
Destroying the shield removes 10% of boss HP and sets all RES to -40% for 10 seconds.
If it became an HP shield, shield break also deals up to 9% max-HP backlash, based on the inherited shield amount.
Shield hits can trigger Favonius and Sacrificial passives. If the shield survives 20 seconds, the boss restores 10% HP.
Ice Coffin: Twinned Crystal Lattice: the boss gains a Cryo Ward; destroying the coffin weakens it, while failure restores HP and triggers a counterattack.
Ice Coffin: Warped Crystal Lattice: Radiance converts the Cryo Ward into a damage-absorbing shield; breaking it causes heavy backlash.
bosses.note: The page does not list a numeric pre-shield RES value. Keep or enter your own resistance for that window; the after-break window is a verified -40% all-RES state for 10 seconds.

traits.name: Ice Coffin: Twinned Crystal Lattice
traits.description: During battle, when the Nemesis's HP falls below a certain threshold, it will encase itself in an Ice Coffin and gain a Cryo Ward to protect itself. While the Ice Coffin is active, the Nemesis will continuously unleash icy storms around itself. If the Ice Coffin is not destroyed, the Nemesis restores a portion of its HP and creates ice swords to launch a counterattack. However, if the Ice Coffin sustaining its life is destroyed, it enters a weakened state for a period of time. Due to the Ley Line disturbance, the Ice Coffin will be more durable. A short time after it is destroyed for the first time, the Nemesis will encase itself in another Ice Coffin.

traits.name: Ice Coffin: Warped Crystal Lattice
traits.description: While the Ice Coffin is active, if the Nemesis is affected by Radiance: Stellar Glimmer, the Ice Coffin's Cryo Ward will transform into a shield that absorbs DMG. Once the shield is destroyed, the Nemesis will take a large amount of backlash DMG.
